verdict.rationale: Buzz's relay is a WebSocket Nostr server that third-party clients and bots can connect to directly using NIP-29 and NIP-42 auth. The buzz-acp harness shows the real-time pattern working: it listens for @mentions on the relay and prompts the agent, which then replies. Bots get their own keypair identities, and the protocol itself serves as the gateway, so no separate bot API is needed. Missing for 10: a dedicated bot/events API reference documenting subscribable event types, filters and delivery semantics, and independent hands-on confirmation of building a real-time bot on the relay.
